resume: Spanish researchers have tested low-height agrivoltaic systems at three vineyards, demonstrating electricity generation with negligible impacts on grape production. The systems achieved land equivalent ratios of 1.16 to 1.53, highlighting their potential to improve land-use […]

titre: Dutch regulator flags EU cyber gap for cloud-controlled home batteries
resume: A Dutch regulator says EU cybersecurity rules should target companies by how much power they can control remotely, not by their size, and wants home energy devices certified independently under the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
